findings.quote: The aq phase was extracted with DCM (3x). The combined org phases were washed with water
findings.message: The extraction products and the phase retained after washing are organic. Unknown top/bottom position does not make the chemical phase identity unknown. The aqueous phase must also remain available between successive extractions.
The filtrate, rather than the drying-agent solids, proceeds to evaporation; the filter step should identify the retained stream.

The generic chromatography method does not operationally represent flash chromatography, silica stationary phase, or the stated eluent composition. Preserve these conditions explicitly in unmapped_actions because the closed Purify fields cannot encode them separately.

patch.value: "The aq phase was extracted with DCM (3x). The combined org phases were washed with water" identifies the organic phases as the collected product-bearing streams, but does not specify their top/bottom positions. The aqueous phase must remain available for successive extractions; the initial separation must preserve both phases.

value.reason: Flash chromatography uses silica and DCM/MeOH 95/5. These explicit purification conditions are not separately represented by the closed Purify fields.
